name: Arkansas Valley Communications
old_description: Motorola Two-Way Radio and Video Security Solutions in Arkansas
about:
Arkansas Valley Communications operates from its headquarters in North Little Rock, Arkansas, with additional offices in Russellville, Fort Smith, Jonesboro, and Fayetteville. The company has specialized in Motorola two-way radio sales and service for over 50 years, establishing itself as Motorola's Partner in the Arkansas region.

AVC designs and delivers complete communication and coverage solutions, including Motorola two-way radio systems, BDA/DAS in-building coverage enhancement, fixed video security, body-worn camera systems, and integrated voice and data networking across multiple sites. The company provides expert installation, repair, and ongoing support services, operating as Motorola's largest warranty service dealer in the region with a large parts inventory, 24/7/365 emergency response, and in-house servicing for all brands of equipment.

The company serves organizations across Arkansas in industries such as construction, education, fire and EMS, government, healthcare, hospitality, law enforcement, manufacturing, mining, oil and gas, property management, recreation, retail, security, transportation and logistics, utilities, and warehousing. Its customers range from public safety agencies and utility crews to industrial facilities and multi-site enterprises requiring reliable communication in challenging environments.

AVC differentiates itself through its Motorola Platinum Channel Partner status, manufacturer-certified technicians, dedicated account and project managers, and a hands-on approach that spans system design, installation, and long-term support. The firm also offers custom engraving, short- and long-term rentals, and pick-up and delivery service to minimize downtime for clients.

name: Arkie Apparel
old_description: Introducing the Arkie Apparel collection: where style meets performance.
about:
Arkie Apparel operates from Rogers, Arkansas, as an Arkansas-focused clothing brand. The company's founding year is not publicly disclosed. The website references "Meet Joe Wilson," suggesting he may be the founder or a key figure. Ownership structure such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status is not specified.

The brand designs and sells a range of apparel and accessories centered on Arkansas outdoor themes. Product lines include short-sleeve and long-sleeve t-shirts, crew sweatshirts, hooded sweatshirts, hats, decals, and a kids' collection. Graphics highlight state landmarks such as the Buffalo National River, Mount Nebo, Beaver Lake, and the Ozark Mountains. The company does not disclose its manufacturing processes, facility size, headcount, or production volumes; it appears to operate as a design and e-commerce brand with wholesale distribution to at least one specialty retailer, Oark Cafe in Oark, Arkansas.

Arkie Apparel targets outdoor enthusiasts, tourists, and residents seeking Arkansas-specific lifestyle apparel. Its direct-to-consumer website serves individual customers, while wholesale placement at Oark Cafe indicates a specialty retail channel. The brand's messaging emphasizes adventure across Arkansas state parks, fishing spots, and trails.

The company positions its collection at the intersection of style and performance, with the tagline "No Limits. Just Adventure." It frames its products as gear for "every season, every activity, and every outdoor challenge," suggesting the brand was created to outfit Arkansas-focused adventures.

name: Arm Factory
old_description: Only 3% of fashion is made in the USA and we’re proud to be part of that community. We are known for having the largest collection of USA made premium knitwear in our industry.
about:
Arm Factory operates from Portland, Maine, offering custom screen printing services for apparel and flatstock. The company positions itself within the small segment of U.S.-made fashion, noting that only 3% of clothing is domestically produced. While its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, the business emphasizes a commitment to domestic production and ethical sourcing.

The shop provides screen printing on garments—including t-shirts, sweatshirts, and other knitwear—as well as poster printing on flat substrates. Services include artwork preparation (accepting vector and raster files), garment selection from a roster of brands such as Royal Apparel, Bella+Canvas, and Gildan, and print placement with multi-color capabilities. Pricing is quoted per unit for garments ($3–$20+) and per print ($1.50–$6), with a $40-per-hour artwork prep fee. The facility’s size, headcount, and annual volume are not specified.

Arm Factory serves brands, businesses, and organizations seeking custom decorated apparel and promotional posters. Its supplier lineup includes makers of organic, recycled, and vegan-approved textiles, such as Continental Clothing and AS Colour, indicating a customer base that values sustainable and ethically sourced blanks. The company also caters to screen printers and wholesalers looking for premium blank goods.

The company differentiates itself through three stated principles: quality, attention to detail, and simplicity. It describes itself as a pioneer in the eco-conscious movement, prioritizing environmentally sound processes and partnerships with factories that uphold labor rights, fair wages, and safe working conditions. These values are presented as the foundation of its brand mission.

name: Armand Manufacturing
old_description: Armand Manufacturing is your source for Vinyl and Poly Packaging, Specialty Products, and Static Control Products.
about:
Armand Manufacturing, Inc. has operated from Henderson, Nevada since its founding in 1948. The company occupies a 42,000-square-foot facility and has spent more than six decades producing plastic bags, covers and specialty items. No founder names or ownership structure are disclosed in the available materials.

The product line spans vinyl envelopes, holders and covers; polyethylene bags and cushion bags; static-control packaging such as shielded bags, shop travelers and badge holders; and fabric covers made from nylon cloth or static-safe nylon cloth. All items are offered with custom sizing, closures and features to match customer specifications. The facility supports this range of sewing, welding and converting operations under one roof.

While the company does not list target industries explicitly, its static-control and cleanroom-oriented products point to electronics assembly, semiconductor handling and related high-tech manufacturing. The vinyl and poly packaging lines also serve general industrial packaging, material handling and storage needs. Custom work is highlighted as a core offering for any application requiring tailored protective covers or bags.

Armand emphasizes that its products are custom designed to meet specific requirements, a capability built on decades of experience in the static-control packaging market dating back to the early recognition of electrostatic discharge risks. The company positions itself as a single source for vinyl, poly, fabric and static-control solutions.

name: Arsco Custom Metals LLC
old_description: Ligature-Resistant Products, Architectural HVAC Covers & Enclosures
about:
Arsco Custom Metals LLC operates from Cincinnati, Ohio, where it has been in business for nearly a century. The company describes itself as a full-service, one-stop shop for sheet metal fabrication — designing, building, and installing custom metal products. No founding year or founder names are disclosed in the source material, and ownership structure (family, veteran, woman-owned, etc.) is not stated.

The company provides end-to-end sheet metal fabrication, including stamping, injection molding, manual forming, automated panel bending, rolling, MIG/TIG and robotic welding, powder coating, pem inserting, punching, and product assembly. It also offers 3D design and engineering, on-site measuring, professional installation, and project management. Arsco produces both standard and custom products such as ligature-resistant HVAC enclosures, television and display enclosures, radiator covers, fan coil/PTAC/induction/radiant heat enclosures, convector and finned-tube enclosures, and sloped louver grilles. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

Arsco serves healthcare and behavioral health facilities, education, transportation, hospitality, defense and aerospace, residential and commercial construction, and corrections. Its customer base ranges from small contract manufacturers to Fortune 500 firms across the U.S. and internationally, with the company noting that over 90% of its customers are repeat buyers.

Arsco emphasizes "intellectual intensity and attention to detail at every stage" as its differentiator, positioning itself as a single-source partner that handles design through installation. It highlights artisan craftsmanship merged with industrial precision, nationwide shipping with in-house packaging, and the ability to support both new construction and renovation projects with irregular field conditions.

name: Ash Millworks
old_description: At ASH Millworks, our mission is to provide quality custom cabinetry and other millwork products.
about:
Founded in Petal, Mississippi, by A.S. 'Skipper' Herring about thirty years ago, ASH Millworks began as a custom millwork shop serving the local community. In 2021, Jimmy Reid and Jeremy Hall acquired the business, bringing a combined 30 years of home remodeling experience—Reid with an architectural background and Hall with a sales background—to continue the founder’s vision of quality wood products for South Mississippi.

The company produces a range of custom and factory-built millwork: cabinets, wood and MDF cabinet doors, entry doors, stair parts, butcherblock countertops, custom moldings, windows and shutters, and specialty items such as hardwood furniture and custom signs. Production relies on computer-aided machine tools to meet precise specifications, though facility size and headcount are not publicly disclosed.

ASH Millworks serves residential builders, remodelers, and homeowners across the Pine Belt and Mississippi Gulf Coast, including Hattiesburg, Gulfport, Biloxi, Wiggins, Columbia, Magee, Jackson, McComb, Brookhaven, Natchez, Hammond, and Slidell. Its customer base spans new construction and renovation projects.

The shop emphasizes a philosophy of 'Custom Cabinets Uniquely Designed for You,' highlighting its experienced team’s workmanship standards and the use of computer-aided machining to deliver consistent quality. The founders’ original goal was to bring high-quality custom wood products to their hometown, a mission the current owners say they continue.

name: Asheville Thermoform Plastics
old_description: Asheville Thermoform Plastics is a family-owned and operated manufacturer that provides custom
about:
Asheville Thermoform Plastics was founded in October 1998 by Bill Trometer in a 2,400-square-foot incubator facility in Fletcher, North Carolina. The family-owned and operated company began with a focus on dunnage and thin-gauge packaging trays made using hand-made molds and fixtures.

Today the firm provides custom thermoforming services for both thin- and heavy-gauge plastics from a 15,000-square-foot building on five acres. Its capabilities include thermoforming, rapid prototyping, 3D printing, 5-axis CNC routing, design and engineering with reverse engineering, SolidWorks and AutoCAD drafting, and in-house tooling fabrication. The company specializes in low-to-medium volume production runs and handles projects from prototype through full production.

The shop serves a range of industries, with communications, medical, and construction called out specifically. Customers span a broad spectrum of markets, and the company emphasizes that design, tooling, prototypes, and full production runs are all available under one roof to keep lead times short.

The business was started after recognizing a need for custom plastic thermoforming services in the Southeast. A second generation of the family is now positioning the company for growth, and the firm notes that its minimum order quantity is one, allowing single-part orders.
